Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

mlxtrx 0.2.0

Archiving key runs

  • archive_run() keeps a complete copy of a clean run: the project file, every input (data, model, regressor, dose and Simulx external files, a config = file), every recorded output and the run’s config.ini copy. Files are stored once each under their SHA-256, inside the store by default or in another folder (options(mlxtrx.archive = ) or archive =). The live project folder stays fully usable.
  • verify_archive() checks every archived copy against its hash.
  • restore_run() rebuilds chosen parts of an archived run in a new folder, never overwriting a file. By default it restores the project and its outputs; model, data and config files are opt-in, and for each model or data file left out it says whether the current file still matches the archived copy. Called interactively without choosing parts, it shows a menu.
  • retrieve_file() fetches one archived file, e.g. the exact data a run used.
  • run_status() gains an archived column.

Status and sources

  • run_status() reports untracked_results for a model whose output folder holds results that no recorded run produced, e.g. from the GUI or lixoftConnectors.
  • source_note() returns a TFL footnote naming the runs behind its source files, and warns when a source file changed. check_output_files() gains project_path.

Reproducibility

  • Each run keeps a copy of the tool’s config.ini in its folder in the store, recorded in run.json. run_status() does not compare it, so editing preferences doesn’t flag models.

Fixes

  • Project files with upper-case extensions (.MLXTRAN, .PKX, .SMLX) are found by run_status() and the check_*() functions.
  • A runner given by name (cmd = "monolix.sh") is located on PATH, so its software version and config.ini copy are recorded.

mlxtrx 0.1.0

First release.

Launching runs

  • mono(), pk() and sim() launch Monolix, PKanalix and Simulx projects, many per call, on the grid (mono24, pk24, sim24) or locally (monolix.sh, pkanalix.sh, simulx.sh).
  • Before launching, the command is checked and check_config_ini() checks the charts-data export settings in the tool’s config.ini.

Run store

  • Runs are recorded in a store of plain JSON files, one folder per run, set with options(mlxtrx.store = ) or store = (default_store()). Files are written atomically and never overwritten, so concurrent sessions can share a store.
  • Each run records the command, settings, software version, user, host, submission and completion times, and every input and output file with its SHA-256 hash. Inputs are every file the project references, plus a config file passed with config =.
  • The software version comes from the run’s summary.txt when Monolix or PKanalix reports it, else from the command.
  • finalize_runs() records runs whose launching session ended before they finished, flagging outputs written well after the rest.

Results

  • Run states: submit_failed, unrecorded, completion_crashed, recorded, recorded_late and no_results.
  • Statistics: Monolix values from summary.txt and observation counts; PKanalix tasks, individuals, compartmental analysis criteria and bioequivalence ratios; Simulx tasks.
  • runs_data() returns every run as one data frame; get_run_files() lists a run’s files.

Status

  • run_status() gives one condition per model, file or folder: never_run, failed, unfinished, inputs_changed, output_edited, output_suspect, clean_late, clean or untracked. print_report_summary() prints it as a report.
  • check_completion_status(), check_project_file_status(), check_input_file_status(), check_output_file_status() and check_output_files() answer narrower questions about project, input and output files.
